Name: Cruiser for the Motorcycle Mod - Continued
Author: mannmodding
Description:
[size=3]This is a content patcher mod that replaces the motorcycle in the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27953]Motorcycle Mod - Continued[/url]﻿ with a motorcycle that looks more like a cruiser.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]Install

[/u][/b][/size][size=3]1. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27953]Motorcycle Mod - Continued[/url]﻿.
4. Finally, download and unzip this mod into the Stardew Valley/Mods.
 

[/size][size=5][b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b][/size]

[size=3]We haven't seen any compatibility issues yet, but feel free to let us know if you find any and we'll do our best to address it.[/size][size=5]

[b][u]Credits
[/u][/b][/size][size=3][b][u]
[/u][/b]Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/akane2010]akane2010[/url] for the creation of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10553]Motorcycle Mod[/url]﻿.
Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CyanFire?gameId=1303]CyanFire[/url] for the continuation of the mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27953]Motorcycle Mod - Continued[/url].[/size][size=5]

[/size]
